targets.query:
from(bucket: "model_comparison")
  |> range(start: -1h)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "model_metric")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "compressed" or r._field == "full")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.param == "accuracy_top1")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.result_type == "actual")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _field: r.result_type + "_" + r._field}))
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "_field"])
